chapter: Southern Illinois roadhouse and St. Louis
title: A little time with Fate Marable on an excursion boat
summary: Joe played briefly on an excursion boat with Fate Marable's St. Louis musicians.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: His sister played in the band once in a while. In the whole length of time I probably only played with him off and on maybe for four weeks. Then I played with Fate a little while on a boat, on an excursion boat. We'd play an excursion, we'd get on the boat and go over to Lovejoy, Illinois and fix picnic lunches, or run up and down
the river to Oakland, Illinois, then back.
Now, Fate Marable had mostly New Orleans guys in his band, didn't he?

Well, Fate had a different bunch of guys, though, in St. Louis altogether. He had musicians from St. Louis. I can't remember none of the guys... Well, he didn't have the regular guys, like Pops Foster and those guys for sure. Otherwise I would have knew him. The first time I met Pops Foster was here in Los Angeles.
